This section provides auto-generated API documentation for the
`timetoalign` Python package, built with
[quartodoc](https://machow.github.io/quartodoc/).

::: {.callout-note}
## Build instructions
The API reference pages are generated by running `quartodoc build`
from the `docs/page/` directory.  To rebuild after adding new public
API, add the class or function name to the appropriate `contents:`
section in `_quarto.yml` under `quartodoc:`, then run `quartodoc build`
again.
:::
